items.title: Respecting our multi-branch lawmaking process

items.title: The Supreme Court refuses to become partisan in two fights over the midterms
items.description: People complain that the current Supreme Court is a partisan institution, with the six Republican appointees deciding cases based on their partisan beliefs.
